messages:
Maya: Quick brain dump  proposal to compress the left rail: put Models, Datasets, Embeddings under one parent (working label: 'Library'). Goal: reduce visual noise and make keyboard scanning faster. Biggest open questions: permalink compatibility, breadcrumb semantics, and focus/scroll behavior.

Omar: +1 for grouping. Permalinks are the scariest part  lots of links in support tickets. We should accept legacy URLs and show canonical path in the bar. Client-side replaceState is the least risky.

Kevin: Agreed. Small router alias table will do for initial rollout. Example: `if (path === '/models') history.replaceState(null, '', '/library/models')`. Keeps history clean and avoids infra migrations.

Eli: Accessibility checklist: 1) Ensure skip-to-content anchors still land inside the workspace panel after any rewrites. 2) Add `aria-current="page"` on active leaf items. 3) Breadcrumbs need `role=navigation` and accessible separators. When a permalink opens a panel, focus the panel heading and announce via a polite live region.

Lina: From usability tests, 'Library' was slightly ambiguous to some folks; 'Assets' was clearer but a bit terse. Recommendation: 'Library' + microcopy under the parent: "Models, datasets, embeddings". That seemed acceptable in testing.

Jonah: Breadcrumb policy: users expect breadcrumbs to restore the same filtered context. Two options: include filter query in breadcrumb links, or let breadcrumbs point to an unfiltered list and rely on permalinks for full context. My vote: breadcrumbs can include a concise filter token (e.g., `?s=owner:me`) for clarity, but avoid weaving long queries into anchors.

Maya: For shareable links: fast path = hash/query snapshot (e.g., `#/library/models?panel=insights&f=owner:me`) which is client-only and requires no backend. Longer term = shortlink service that stores snapshot server-side and returns `/s/abcd12`. Kevin: estimate for shortlink infra vs hash approach?

Kevin: Hash encoding ships this sprint. Shortlink service is a small API + DB + ACL checks  estimate 2 sprints to build and secure. We'll document the interim approach to set expectations.

Omar: Scroll/keyboard nuance: preserve left rail scrollTop per cluster so switching between siblings doesn't jump. Implement a tiny client map keyed by clusterId and restore in `beforeRouteEnter`. Roving tabindex for arrow-key nav into children.

Eli: On permalink load that opens a panel, do `panelHeading.focus({preventScroll: true})` and set live region text like "Panel opened: Insights". Also double-check that focus isn't trapped in the rail (tab order flows to main content).

Maya: Action items: Omar -> prototype client-side alias + per-cluster scroll state. Eli -> update a11y checklist and add a SR test case for permalink flows. Kevin -> shortlink vs hash scope and doc. Lina -> finalize parent label copy. Jonah -> brief on breadcrumb tokenization. I'll consolidate into a rollout note with mock screenshots.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: D-7531 "Left rail regroup: library mode, permalinks, breadcrumbs & a11y" (assignee: Maya). :white_check_mark:

Maya: Thanks team  I'll post mocks and a short video later today; ping me here for quick reviews.
